context_and_flow.ux_intent: Authenticating a user to access their account or directing them to sign up.
ux_patterns: The fish illustration is a mascot/decorative element placed centrally between the header and the form.
The color scheme uses a soft, warm coral tone which is distinctive for the brand.
The UI uses high-contrast black text and elements against the background color.
Accessibility: The password field has a 'hide/show' icon, and the terms text is clearly linked.
The design uses a clean sans-serif typeface consistent with modern mobile apps.
